generationPrompts: Create a square seamless albedo texture of bundled reed thatch for a muted painterly low-poly fantasy game. Warm grey-straw, faded oat and subdued olive-brown tones, compact flattened reed bundles with readable medium-scale layered fibers, restrained detail and soft tonal variation. Flat orthographic diffuse color only, evenly lit. The texture must repeat seamlessly on BOTH axes, with no bundle bands or edge pattern ending abruptly at top, bottom, left, or right. Avoid large individual protruding reeds. No lighting gradients, directional highlights, shadows, vignette, text, border, props, objects, or standalone plants. Uniform material coverage edge to edge. Architectural thatch surface intended for a 2m repeat.
